NON COMPETITIVE MEMORANDUM FOR SIMPLIFIED ACQUISITION ACTIONS

IAW FAR 13.106-3(b)(3)

1. REQUIRING AGENCY – DOJ/Bureau of Prisons, FCC Terre Haute

2. NATURE/DESCRIPTION OF ACTION BEING APPROVED – Urgency

3. DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES OR SERVICES REQUIRED TO MEET THE AGENCY’S NEEDS Agency requires installation of Hot Water Heater and Tank unit. The estimated value of this requirement is $39,632.00. The rental will be a 30-Days agreement.

4. IDENTIFICATION OF STATUTORY AUTHORITY PERMITTING OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION – 41 U.S.C. 253; 41 U.S.C. 1901(e)

5. DEMONSTRATION THAT THE PROPOSED CONTRACTOR’S UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS OR THE

NATURE OF THE ACQUISITION REQUIRES USE OF THE AUTHORITY CITED:

On or about December 12th, 2025, the Facilities Department experienced a loss of hot water for the Federal Prison Camp at FCC Terre Haute. While troubleshooting the hot water system it was determined that a new heating coil was needed to make the repairs and restore hot water. Vendors were called and quotes were received for the parts needed with an extended lead time. Due to cold weather the Facilities Manager deemed this an emergency and called in an agency to provide a portable water heater/boiler to provide hot water till parts can be received and repairs to be made.

6. Purchase Order Number: 15B41826P00000047

CONTRACTING OFFICER’S CERTIFICATION

I certify this justification is accurate and complete to the best of knowledge and belief.

Luke Bonner, Contracting Officer
